name: Transfer learning and meta-learning on PDE families
description: TransferBenchmarkPipeline (pre-train 3000 epochs on a source member, fine-tune 1000 on two targets per family with each freezing strategy) and MetaBenchmarkPipeline (MAML / Reptile, 500 meta-epochs, K-shot adaptation up to 200 steps) on the Burgers nu, heat alpha and wave c families (examples/benchmark_suite/13_transfer_meta_benchmark.py; it imports pinneapple_arena.transfer_benchmark / meta_benchmark, now in pinneapple_tools.benchmark_suite). Quick: the script's --fast sizes.
